title: .opx/config.json
description: Configuration for opx, the _optionally_ opinionated front-end toolkit. Each concern (lint, build, release, test) enables one or more plugins by short name.

pluginSetting.description: How to enable a plugin: a flag, a path to a custom config file, or inline configuration.

oneOf.description: A simple flag to enable or disable the plugin with default behaviors.
A relative path to a file containing the custom configuration for the plugin.
Inline configuration settings for the plugin.

dynamicTask.description: File-type-specific plugins keyed by short name (e.g. 'js', 'css', 'md', 'json').
